Miller Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Max Miller is an Assistant Professor in the Finance Unit at Harvard Business School. His research lies at the intersection of finance, macroeconomics, and political economy, aiming to combine insights from asset pricing to improve our understanding of public policy and political institutions.
